sql:
SELECT
    coalesce(c.Occupation, 'Unknown') AS customer_segment,
    sum(os.SalesAmount - os.ReturnAmount - os.DiscountAmount - os.TotalCost) AS total_profit
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS os
INNER JOIN retail.DimCustomer AS c
    ON os.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
GROUP BY customer_segment
ORDER BY total_profit DESC
LIMIT 1
